fichas.title: Central hospital kitchen with service yard
fichas.summary: The kitchen is located on the supply level to support the flow of deliveries, storage, preparation, processing and serving. Food is prepared and portioned centrally, then transported to wards on serving trolleys; the same trolleys return washing-up. The page illustrates the kitchen with service yard at Luckenwalde Hospital and a kitchen building ground-floor plan, alongside a basement plan. A special diet kitchen, goods reception, stores, vegetable preparation, cold rooms, central washing-up and staff facilities are specified. A central kitchen may supply several hospitals.
spaces: Cold room with meat, fish and dairy compartments
Kitchen staff changing rooms and social rooms
uses: Prepare and cook normal and diet meals
Portion meals and distribute them to hospital wards
Receive and store food and supplies
Clean vegetables and manage kitchen waste
Wash dishes and clean serving trolleys
furniture_equipment: Worktops for dirty and clean racks
